project: Whispers of Japan / EOJ16 和の聖夜
generator: built-in image_gen; one image per call
prompt_handling: 初回は各txt全文を変更せず使用。02〜05は01を参照。05の再生成はtxt全文の末尾に記録した補足を追加。

measurement.luminance: Y = 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B; encoded RGB, 0..255, no linearization
measurement.dark_fraction: Y < 16 の画素数 / 全画素数
measurement.retry_count: 初回を除いた生成し直し回数

images.prompt_text_verbatim: A small wooden island church above a quiet fishing cove at dusk, just after sunset. The cove is a small, quiet fishing cove on a remote island in western Japan in midwinter, in the days before Christmas. Calm dark-blue sea water fills the lower left foreground and reaches into the middle distance, held between two low rocky headlands covered with dark pines. On a gentle slope above the shore, right of centre in the middle distance, stands one small old wooden church in the Japanese island style: a simple hall with a grey tiled Japanese roof (kawara), white plastered and dark wooden walls, a short square wooden bell tower over the entrance with a small plain wooden cross on top, and a row of tall, narrow arched windows along its side. A few low grey-tiled fishermen's houses sit lower down by the shore, small and dark, and two or three small wooden fishing boats are pulled up on the pebble beach. The church is the only tall building and the only one with lit windows. No people, no figures, no animals, no birds. No Christmas tree, no Santa Claus, no reindeer, no gifts, no wreaths, no red and green decorations, no fairy lights, no neon, no stained-glass saints, no statues, no graves. No temples, no shrines, no torii, no pagodas, no stone lanterns, no paper lanterns, no bridges, no lighthouse, no ships, no harbour walls. No snow, no cherry blossoms, no plum blossoms, no camellias, no maple leaves, no autumn colours, no persimmons, no bamboo, no pampas grass. No snow yet: the pines are dark green and the roofs are bare grey tile. The sun has just set behind the left headland out of frame: the sky is a soft gradated wash from warm apricot low over the sea to rose and pale violet above, and the calm water reflects these colours in long soft bands. The windows of the church have just been lit and glow a small warm amber against the cooling evening. The first star shows faintly high above the bell tower. Apricot, rose, pale violet, deep sea blue, dark pine green, warm amber window light. Japanese shin-hanga woodblock print in the manner of the 1920s-30s revival: flat layered areas of colour, visible woodgrain in the flat passages, softly gradated sky (bokashi), Western perspective and cast light held inside Japanese printmaking. The sea, the headlands, the pines, the church, the houses and the boats are drawn as part of the print, in the same flat woodblock manner, never photographic. Calm, no people, no figures. Strong clear difference between the light and dark masses so the image still reads when reduced to a thumbnail. No text, no signature, no seal stamp, no lettering of any kind. No modern objects: no power lines, no utility poles, no street lamps, no vehicles, no plastic, no road markings. Wide 16:9 landscape. Exposed so that texture is clearly visible everywhere. Shadows are lifted and open, full of visible detail, nothing crushed to pure black. High dynamic range, rich texture even in the darkest areas.

visual_check.notes: 日没直後の桃色・紫色の空、教会の琥珀色の窓明かり。雪なし。
